decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The storage area/facilities hereby permitted shall be used only for storage ancillary to the retail use of the premises and for not other purpose (including any purpose in Class B8 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 or any order revoking or re-enacting that order).

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west flank   walls  of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Demolition of existing single storey detached store/garage and the erection of a new detached single storey store/garage.
